channel.title: Claude Code Live Cheatsheet
channel.description: Auto-updating cheatsheet for Claude Code — keyboard shortcuts, commands, tips, and more.

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.237 highlights
item.description:
• Built-in Concise output style: results-first, no preamble; in /config (v2.1.237)
  • ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_MODEL env var sets initial model; /model picks persist (v2.1.236)
  • SendMessage notify_when_idle: cross-session idle notifications (v2.1.236)
  • Auto mode: Monitor rules aside, consistent classifier across providers (v2.1.236)
  • /goal idle auto check-in escalates: 30m → 1h → 2h (v2.1.236)

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.237
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] Concise output style: Built-in style: leads with results, skips preamble; select in /config Output style
- [config-env] forward_user_identity

Full changelog

• Fixed prompt caching for sessions using an LLM gateway or custom base URL
• Added a built-in "Concise" output style: Claude leads with results and skips preamble and narration, while doing the work just as thoroughly. Select it under Output style in /config.

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.236
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_MODEL: Set initial model for new sessions; /model picks persist across restarts
~ [skills-agents] SendMessage: Resume agents; ListAgents; bare-name delivery; RC by name; refuses oversized/burst; notify_when_idle
~ [config-env] ANTHROPIC_MODEL: Forces model; /model picks don't persist; org restrictions can override
~ [slash-commands] /goal [condition]: Set completion condition; auto-clears on fatal error; auto check-in 30m→1h→2h
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_PREFIX_STAGGER_MS

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.235
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] spellcheck: Underline misspelled words in prompt using aspell/hunspell/ispell
~ [skills-agents] SendMessage: Resume agents; ListAgents; bare-name delivery; RC by name; refuses oversized
- [config-env] command (plugin source)

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.234
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_PROJECT_DIR_NAME: Short name for per-project transcript dir
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_GOAL_CHECKIN_MINUTES: Goal check-in interval in min; 0 opts out (default 30)
~ [slash-commands] /goal [condition]: Set completion condition; auto-clears on fatal error; check-in after 30 min
~ [slash-commands] /permissions: View/update permissions; opens while Claude is working
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_WEBFETCH_CACHE_TTL_MS
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.233
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_TOOL_MEMORY_LIMIT: Opt-in memory cgroup limit for Bash commands on Linux
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_WEBFETCH_CACHE_TTL_MS: WebFetch URL cache TTL in ms (default 900000 = 15 min)
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS: Restore todo/task tools on Opus 4.8+, Sonnet 5+, Fable 5+
+ [config-env] forward_user_identity: Apps gateway: send signed-in user identity headers for spend attribution
~ [cli-flags] -w: Git worktree; GitLab MR URLs
~ [cli-flags] claude agents: Agent dashboard; MRs as !N; --cwd, --add-dir, --settings, --mcp-config, --model, --effort, --json
- [config-env] axScreenReader
- [config-env] dialogExpiry
- [config-env] crossSessionInbound
- [config-env] autoMode.$defaults

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.232
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [skills-agents] subagent_type: fork: Inherit full conversation + prompt cache; on by default
~ [skills-agents] background: true: Background task; non-teammate spawns default to bg in interactive
~ [skills-agents] SendMessage: Resume agents; ListAgents; bare-name session delivery; RC by name (macOS/Linux)
~ [skills-agents] /code-review [level] [pr#]: Reviews diff or PR; remembers effort; --comment, --fix; high+ runs in bg; ultra=cloud
~ [keyboard-shortcuts] @: File mention + autocomplete; @session to cross-session message
~ [config-env] "owner/*" marketplaces: Wildcards & bare URLs in strict/blocked; allowed/additional aliases; GitLab repos
- [skills-agents] mcpServers

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.229
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [cli-flags] claude remote-control --continue: Resume most recent Remote Control session
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_PREFIX_STAGGER_MS: Stagger sibling agent fan-outs for prefix caching; 0 disables
~ [skills-agents] SendMessage: Resume agents; ListAgents; bare-name session delivery; RC by name (macOS/Linux)
~ [cli-flags] claude self-hosted-runner: Machines/containers as CC session hosts; --base-dir required on Windows (Team/Ent)
- [cli-flags] claude plugin prune
- [config-env] autoMode.hard_deny
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_UNKNOWN_MODEL_WINDOW_ENFORCEMENT

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.228
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [workflows-tips] Write tool: Newer models can overwrite unread files, matching Edit tool rules

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.225
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

~ [skills-agents] SendMessage: Resume agents; cross-session ListAgents; start RC sessions by name (macOS/Linux)

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.224
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [cli-flags] claude self-hosted-runner: Turn your machines/containers into CC session hosts (Team/Ent)
+ [cli-flags] archive (plugin source): Install plugins from zip over HTTPS; SHA-256 pinning
+ [config-env] ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_REGION_PREFIX: Prefer specific Bedrock cross-region inference profile over AWS_REGION
+ [config-env] crossSessionInbound: Hold cross-session messages for approval in bypass-permissions sessions
+ [config-env] dialogExpiry: Expiry for cross-session message approval dialogs
+ [workflows-tips] Self-hosted runner: Own machines/containers as CC session hosts; claude self-hosted-runner (Team/Ent)
~ [config-env] sandbox.credentials: Block credentials; mask, extract, JWT maskClaims, AWS SigV4; needs tlsTerminate
~ [skills-agents] SendMessage: Resume agents; cross-session with ListAgents for discovery (macOS/Linux)
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENTS_PER_SESSION
- [config-env] workflowSizeGuideline
- [config-env] sandbox.filesystem.disabled
- [cli-flags] claude ultrareview [target]
- [cli-flags] claude plugin details <name>

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.223
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [cli-flags] --teleport <session id>: Continue a cloud session locally
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT: Hold 1M-window models to 200K via auto-compaction
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_UNKNOWN_MODEL_WINDOW_ENFORCEMENT: Restore pre-223 behavior for unknown model IDs
+ [config-env] "owner/*" marketplaces: Wildcard in strictKnownMarketplaces/blockedMarketplaces for all org repos
~ [slash-commands] /review <pr>: Alias for /code-review
~ [skills-agents] /code-review [effort]: Reviews current diff or PR; remembers last effort; --comment, --fix; ultra for deep cloud
- [config-env] emojiCompletionEnabled
- [config-env] CLAUDE_AX_SCREEN_READER
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_FORWARD_SUBAGENT_TEXT
- [cli-flags] --forward-subagent-text

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.222
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

~ [slash-commands] /remote-control: Bridge to claude.ai/code (/rc); auto-start only via user-scope settings

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.221
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [keyboard-shortcuts] Ctrl+Alt+F: Toggle Focus view (VSCode: hide tool activity behind expandable summary)
~ [keyboard-shortcuts] :shortcode:: Emoji autocomplete in prompt; accepts alternate shortcodes (:thumbsup:, :love:)
~ [config-env] sandbox.credentials: Block credential files/env; mode:mask = sentinel copy (Linux/WSL), deny (macOS)
~ [slash-commands] /status: Show session status, warnings, session kind (interactive/attached/unattended)
~ [slash-commands] /fork: Copy conversation into new background session with its own worktree

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.219
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] sandbox.network.strictAllowlist: Deny non-allowlisted hosts for sandboxed commands without prompting
+ [config-env] DirectoryAdded: Fires after /add-dir or SDK register_repo_root registers new working dir
+ [config-env] workflowSizeGuideline: Set dynamic workflow size guideline from any settings file
~ [skills-agents] Nesting depth: Sub-agents nest up to depth 3; set CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH=1 to disable
~ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH: Nested subagent spawning; default depth 3; set 1 to disable
~ [workflows-tips] 1M context: Sonnet 5 (default) + Opus 5 + Opus 4.8 (Max/Team/Ent)
~ [workflows-tips] Dynamic workflows: Orchestrates agents; default medium (<15); triggers on 'run a workflow', 'workflow:'
- [config-env] CLAUDE_ENABLE_STREAM_WATCHDOG
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES
